supplemental_items.interpretation: Post-primary orders traverse visible cycles then their post_pl3_orders in encounter order for both directions. A stop index strictly greater than end skips the order; equal is retained and no local missing-stop fallback exists. Accepted orders are relabeled against the same finalized primary and serialized with opposite conceptual owner (bearish if bullish, otherwise bullish); non-null cycle id optionally adds transformed cycleId. Qualification defaults None only for absent attribute. Horizon is end candle timestamp plus timeframe. If visible cycles exist, last encounter's status wins unconditionally; otherwise non-null qualification strictly earlier than horizon yields waiting-for-stopall-break, while equality, later or absent qualification yields waiting-for-matching-behaviors. Return key postPH3Orders only for exact bullish flag, otherwise postPL3Orders; no sort or requalification.
